hold_reason: review: Alibaba: The Hindi definition 'इफेक्ट को अगले फ्रेम से हटाना' (removing effect from the next frame) is incorrect. Bypassing an effect means disabling it entirely so the signal passes through unchanged, not just removing it from a specific frame.
objections: Alibaba: The Hindi definition 'इफेक्ट को अगले फ्रेम से हटाना' (removing effect from the next frame) is incorrect. Bypassing an effect means disabling it entirely so the signal passes through unchanged, not just removing it from a specific frame.
Google: The definition is incorrect; bypass in video editing/software means to temporarily disable an effect or plugin without removing it, not specifically 'removing it from the next frame'.
NVIDIA: Hindi meaning 'इफेक्ट को अगले फ्रेम से हटाना या न चलाना।' is inaccurate; 'bypass' means skipping/disabling an effect entirely, not specifically removing it from the next frame.
